files.summary: separate older recovery behavior from accepted death rules and acknowledge delivered finite fire watches
edits: This document describes the pinned review branch. [Lifecycle and protection](lifecycle-and-protection.md) records Mike’s newer accepted death/reincarnation and simulated-departure choices, already implemented on its pinned main revision but not integrated here. The older collapse/recovery observations below are baseline facts, not requirements to reinstate when synchronizing.

On this older review baseline, a living player collapses at zero while other controllers die; recovery requires collapse, health below 30% or food below 20 and a valid walkable safe-return point, then raises health to at least 65%, food to 45 and energy to 65. The later accepted main policy replaces that player recovery path with actual death and explicit Continue; its corpse, retained possessions and scar rules remain with the linked lifecycle owner. Creator revival remains distinct and must not duplicate a reincarnated player or revive an old body into a second controlled life
The older review branch’s player collapse means zero health is not a player death on this baseline; the accepted main revision changes that distinction as described above
. Integrate the selected player-death and one-attack lethal-review behavior without recreating it; broader PvP/indirect harm, ghost experience and ordinary difficult NPC revival

. [Finite chosen fire watches and camp requests](camp-routines.md) are also delivered; broader voluntary learning/reuse, long-term attendance and richer activity composition remain in their focused trackers rather than a task to rebuild finite tending
